title: Hall of Famer Terrell Owens Knocks Out Man Outside CVS In LA
htmlContent:
The former NFL receiver, Terrell Owens, was reportedly involved in a disturbing incident during the weekend.

TMZ Sports reports that the Hall of Fame receiver was involved in a physical altercation outside a CVS store in Los Angeles, California.

Owens would have tried to make peace, but during a physical encounter, he ended up hitting a man.

"Terrell Owens knocked out a man outside a CVS in Los Angeles after the guy allegedly harassed people in the store ... and TMZ Sports has obtained video of the fight captured by a witness. The incident went down Saturday night around 11:30 PM at the pharmacy in Inglewood, CA," TMZ Sports reports.

Owens tells us he intended to quickly stop by the store and grab a few necessities. While inside, T.O. says a 49ers fan approached him and they had a friendly conversation. That's when things took a turn.

Terrell says a second man -- the guy who was ultimately clocked -- started talking crap to the fan Owens was conversing with. The aggressor threatened to beat up the men outside, according to witnesses.
